description: This is a Python source file defining the LLMContext class, which manages conversation context, including messages, tools, multimedia content, and context transformation functions for a large language model (LLM) interface within the Pipecat project. It handles message creation, conversion, and management of context-specific data, supporting various media types and integration with OpenAI's types and structures.

classes.name: LLMSpecificMessage
classes.description: A container for a context message that is specific to a particular LLM service, enabling service-specific message types while maintaining compatibility with the universal format.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context for LLM interactions, including message history, tools, multimedia content, and context translation. Provides methods for message management, multimedia message creation, and context state management.
